quest.title: Project Connectivity
quest.description: Daya from Kshahrewar seems to be busy with something...

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: Hello there! I'm Daya from Kshahrewar. Are you here to take part in the Wisdom Gala too?

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: This is the new game that our Darshan has put forth: "Project Connectivity"!

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a go at it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If I recall, Kshahrewar's specialty is...

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: We study mechanics and architecture, yes.

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: Uh, seems like I've gone off-topic. So, to take part in this Gala, many of our students put their heads together...

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: Basically, players will need to use the various objects that we have prepared to... well, create a pathway.

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: Laying down bridges, setting up stairs... The eventual goal is to create a path for people to travel on that can reach its destination.

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: Once you have finished constructing that road, we will conduct a final verification, just like how we would test completed buildings.

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: Essentially, you just need to set up a safe road to attain success.

response.speaker: Daya
response.text: Don't worry, don't worry! You're not being asked to construct anything in real life.

response.speaker: Daya
response.text: If something goes wrong and the road collapses, we'll just have to rebuild it. We're not putting limits on the number of tries you have either.

response.speaker: Daya
response.text: Just let your imagination run free and build as beautiful as a road can be!

response.speaker: Daya
response.text: Alright. In that case, if you'll look over this way...

choices.text: Sorry, I'm a little busy right now.

response.speaker: Daya
response.text: Ah, is that so... It's alright. Our booth will be open for the entire duration of the Gala.

response.speaker: Daya
response.text: Whenever you feel like having a go, you can just come to me.

choices.text: I haven't much of a knack for architecture.

dialogues.speaker: Daya
dialogues.text: (If only building something in real life was this easy. *sigh*)
